verdict.rationale: CLI is scriptable and headless (init/start work without login, confirmed by hands-on probes), and RLS/auth/policies can be defined via SQL migrations applied through the CLI, so an agent can stand up schema+auth+policies without a UI. However, no direct evidence of a single scripted command sequence combining migrations, auth config, and policy application, and community reports flag local-dev/CLI stability and migration pain points as ongoing weaknesses.
